d: Why is Iran persecuting the Bahai community? From the origins of the Bahai Faith in 19th-century Iran to the iconic Lotus Temple in Delhi, this episode of The Lallantop’s Tarikh explores the history, beliefs and persecution of one of the world's youngest religions. Discover the story of Bahaullah, the Bab, Iran’s largest religious minority, and decades of discrimination, arrests, executions, forced evictions, demolished homes, denial of education and employment, and attacks on Bahai cemeteries. We also examine recent human rights reports, religious freedom, Iran’s crackdown on Bahais, and…
